description: Strongest when the opponent has just stacked three in a column 5 vertical with the cell above empty, so the mover must block in column 5 (same pattern in other columns does not fire; in column 4 it is strongly negative). Weaker, diffuse firing in mid-to-late games where columns 2 and 3 are full and column 4 is full or poisoned, so play must go to column 5/6 or 1. Off when the forced move is column 0 or 4.
effect: Weak: forcing it high shifts about 0.05-0.12 probability away from columns 2/3 toward columns 1, 4 and 5; zeroing it changes moves by at most 0.02.
notes: Col-5 vertical-three rule alone: F1 0.30 (precision 0.70, recall 0.19). Adding a 'centre closed (cols 2,3 full, col 4 full/poisoned, col 5 safe, ply<=30)' branch: best F1 0.319 (P 0.35, R 0.30), AUROC 0.64, simulation share -0.02. Minimal pairs suggest the unit tracks the model's choice of column 5 (vs 0/4) more than one board pattern; most firing is not captured. Treat as mixture. Synthesis max 4.96 < dev max 5.22.
